verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers API docs, pricing, rate limits, model comparison tables, and changelog capability flags, but contains no reference to a published model card or system card describing training approach, safety evaluations, or intended use for the flagship model. gpt-comm-1 only mentions ad-hoc eval comparisons in a forum thread, not an official system card. missing for 10: a citable system/model card document, training methodology disclosure, published evaluation results (safety/capability benchmarks), and an intended-use/limitations section.
